verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a company-formation SaaS, and such a platform could plausibly offer user-configurable background automations (for example, recurring compliance or filing workflows), so the axis applies. The evidence only shows one-time service steps that Atlas performs on the user's behalf: filing the 83(b), obtaining the EIN, and issuing equity. Nothing shows users can set up their own autonomous automations or background agents.
